from statsmodels.stats.diagnostic import acorr_ljungbox

lb = acorr_ljungbox(fit.resid, lags=[10, 20], return_df=True)
print(lb)   # small lb_pvalue => residuals are NOT white noise
caption: A small Ljung-Box p-value means the model still has unmodeled autocorrelation.
